product_family: AI-powered eCommerce product content generation and data enrichment platform. Offers bulk product description generation, metadata creation, image enhancement, content audit, and integrated chatbot (ShopAssist). Native integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, Akeneo, Wix, Squarespace.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification found on vendor domain or in trust/security pages.
certifications.source: https://describely.ai (comprehensive search; no trust center or certification pages discovered)

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found on vendor domain or in trust/security pages.
certifications.source: https://describely.ai (comprehensive search; no trust center or certification pages discovered)

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of GDPR certification or specific GDPR compliance framework in available public documentation. Company does not market GDPR compliance; privacy policy exists but no formal GDPR DPA or compliance posture documented.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Terms of Service explicitly disclaims HIPAA compliance: 'The Describely site is not tailored to comply with industry-specific regulations such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA).'

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Payment processing delegated to Stripe; vendor site does not claim PCI DSS compliance.

privacy.ai_training_note: Vendor explicitly does not use product information/customer data for training their AI models. According to vendor's blog and comparison materials: 'Describely doesn't use product information for training data.' All AI outputs powered by OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs; customer data used only for generating requested content within that session.
privacy.data_region: Stored on AWS per vendor statements. Specific AWS region / data residency not documented; no region-selection options mentioned.
sources: Search result: blog comparison material stating no use of product information for training data and AWS data storage

security.name: Data Encryption
security.value: Vendor states it encrypts data and stores it on AWS; the wording does not specify whether encryption applies in transit, at rest, or both.

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC) with multi-factor authentication (MFA)
security.source: Vendor blog comparison materials and security feature descriptions

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Conducts regular penetration testing on the platform

security.name: Payment Processing
security.value: Payment data processed and stored by Stripe (PCI DSS compliant third party)

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Personal information retained only as long as necessary for stated purposes; deleted or anonymized when no ongoing legitimate business need exists

security.name: Age Restriction
security.value: Does not knowingly collect data from children under 18 years of age

security.name: Content Moderation
security.value: AI content guidelines prohibit harmful use cases; vendor reserves right to terminate access for policy violations
security.source: Vendor user content policy (from search results)

products.name: Product Description Generator
products.data_scope: Product catalog data, brand guidelines, eCommerce platform content
products.notes: Core product. Generates product descriptions, titles, meta descriptions, keywords, and SEO metadata. Uses OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs. Supports bulk generation (hundreds to thousands of products).

products.name: Product Data Enrichment
products.notes: Fills gaps in product catalogs with accurate details. Sources data from vendor-specified sources. No use of customer data for model training.

products.name: Content Audit
products.data_scope: Product content, claim verification, error detection
products.notes: Verifies product claims, catches errors, ensures consistency. Does not train on audit data.

products.name: AI Images (feature)
products.notes: Bulk image enhancement capability. Integrated into main platform.

products.name: ShopAssist (chatbot)
products.notes: Seamless eCommerce chatbot integration. Separate product within platform family.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based SaaS. Pricing tiers are not publicly disclosed; accessible via login.
compare.data_residency: AWS. Specific region not documented; no regional options.
compare.key_differentiators: Purpose-built for eCommerce (vs. general-purpose AI writing tools). Brand voice customization. Bulk generation at scale. Direct integrations with major eCommerce platforms and PIMs. Optimizes for both search engines and AI discovery engines.

flags: Startup company (founded 2023, unfunded) with minimal certifications, typical for its stage. Transparency about HIPAA non-compliance is a positive signal.
No trust center, no audit reports, and no formal compliance documentation are publicly available, consistent with startup maturity.
The company rebranded from 'Copysmith'. Not to be confused with other vendors named 'Copysmith' or 'Copy.ai'.
